VR.title: 18Birdies & Arccos Make Meta Glasses Act As Your AI Golf Caddy
VR.summary: 18Birdies and Arccos apps now integrate with Meta smart glasses, providing users with an AI-powered golf caddy experience in the US and Canada.

VR.title: A camera-free smart glasses startup just hit $1 billion, and Meta should notice
VR.summary: Even Realities raises $150 million at a $1 billion valuation, positioning itself as a strong competitor in the smart glasses market.

VR.title: Smart Contact Lenses Move Closer to Reality as XPANCEO Expands JBD Display Partnership
VR.summary: XPANCEO expands its partnership with JBD to develop advanced micro-displays for smart contact lenses, bringing the technology closer to reality.

VR.title: HTC’s Revenue Stabilizes as XR Pioneer Pins Hopes on AI, Smart Glasses and Enterprise
VR.summary: HTC reports stabilized revenue amid ongoing efforts to pivot towards XR and AI hardware, revealing cautious optimism at its annual shareholder meeting.

VR.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades Leaves Early Access After 10 Years
VR.summary: The popular VR shooter Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades exits Early Access after a decade of updates, officially launching its 1.0 version.

VR.title: Subscription Now Required For Longer Access To Some Meta Glasses Features
VR.summary: Meta introduces a 'Meta One Premium' subscription for extended access to select advanced features of its smart glasses.

AI.title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
AI.summary: Meta launches its Muse Image model, enabling AI-generated images that incorporate other Instagram users across its platforms.

AI.title: Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web
AI.summary: Anthropic's Claude Cowork AI platform is now available on mobile and web, expanding access beyond its desktop app.

AI.title: Anthropic wants to develop its own drugs
AI.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Science, an AI workbench designed to assist scientists by integrating fragmented tools and datasets.

AI.title: Oracle’s 21,000 layoffs help drive its debt-fueled AI investments
AI.summary: Oracle's recent layoffs are part of a strategy to fuel its substantial investments in AI-driven data center infrastructure.

AI.title: Some of the nation’s rich are letting AI teach their kids
AI.summary: Wealthy Americans are increasingly turning to AI for educational purposes, opting for AI tutors over traditional schooling methods.

AI.title: A behind-the-scenes look at Midjourney’s medical scanner leaves many questions unanswered

NFL.title: Chiefs' Kelce, Swift marry in ceremony at MSG

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Free agent OL Brady Christensen says he's cleared to return after torn Achilles
NFL.summary: Veteran offensive lineman Brady Christensen announces he is cleared to return to the field after recovering from a torn Achilles.

NFL.title: 49ers sign fourth-round pick Gracen Halton
NFL.summary: The San Francisco 49ers have signed fourth-round draft pick Gracen Halton, adding depth to their roster.

NFL.title: Sean Payton makes it clear Broncos want to keep Ja'Quan McMillian long term
NFL.summary: Sean Payton confirms the Broncos' intention to retain cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian long-term after using a second-round tender.

NFL.title: Late Cowboys' player Kneeland diagnosed with CTE
NFL.summary: Former Cowboys player Marshawn Kneeland has been posthumously diagnosed with CTE, highlighting ongoing concerns about brain injuries in football.
